javbusDownloader.description: Paste a batch of product codes. Bakabase looks each one up on Javbus, saves its cover and picks one magnet — largest size first, then Chinese subtitle hints inside the same quality tier. Site address, cookie and proxy come from Third-party configuration → AV sources (javbus).
javbusDownloader.placeholder.codes: Paste codes — any separator works (newline / comma / space / a javbus link). Pause typing and they turn into chips above. Anything unrecognized stays here.
javbusDownloader.tip.sizeTolerance: How far below the largest candidate still counts as the same quality tier. Subtitle hints only break ties inside a tier.
javbusDownloader.column.title: Title
javbusDownloader.hint.nothingRecognized: No code recognized — "Add as-is" is the fallback
